label: Qwen Remove Background
description: Qwen-Image 2.1 removes the background of one frame and returns RGBA. Output: the frame at plate size with the model's alpha (premultiplied on read).
usage: Removes the background of one frame and writes RGBA (Qwen Image 2.1).
Pick the frame with 'frame' (Set to current frame) - only that frame is sent.
Say what to remove / keep in the prompt; the wording decides whether Qwen returns real alpha.
Crop: tick 'crop' and move the box in the viewer to send only that area (more detail on small fixes).
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.

highlights: 'roll off' (default) compresses values above 1 going in: highlights return approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed and new near-whites come back hot. 'clip' cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open.
License (checked 2026-11): Qwen Research License - research or evaluation only. Paid work needs a separate license from Qwen.

output.tooltip: Qwen works on display-referred images, so highlights are rolled off or clipped (see the highlights knob). The alpha is the model's; use it as a matte over the original plate where colour matters.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.default: Remove the background, and output a PNG image
knobs.tooltip: The template's instruction. Name what to keep to steer it, e.g. 'Keep only the man in the red coat, remove everything else'. The plate is <image1>.

knobs.name: resolution
knobs.label: resolution
knobs.tooltip: Pixel budget (aspect kept). 0 = the plate's own size; up to 2048 (use 2048 for 4K plates). The result is scaled back to plate size.

knobs.name: cfg
knobs.label: cfg
knobs.tooltip: Keep 1 (official). Raise it only together with a negative prompt.

knobs.name: consistency
knobs.label: consistency LoRA
knobs.tooltip: Qwen Image 2.1 Consistency LoRA (ausboss): keeps the edit on the plate's framing - no drift in scale or position, untouched areas stay untouched. It can resist big moves (a new pose) and leave a faint ghost after large removals - turn it off for those.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: roll off (default): the plate and refs go in through ACES Output - sRGB and the result comes back through its inverse, so highlights are compressed instead of cut. Highlights come back approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed, and new near-white pixels come back hot (display 0.98 = about 7, 1.0 = about 16). clip: values above 1 reach the model as 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. Comp only the changed area.

knobs.name: negative_prompt
knobs.label: negative prompt
knobs.tooltip: Only used when cfg is above 1.
